slides: 1. Strong women usually get picked early
A woman with real value rarely stays single into her thirties. Most get chosen in their twenties by a man who saw her worth and acted fast. So when you meet her single at 30, ask what her story is.
2. Look at how she spent her peak years

The ones still single past 30 often spent their twenties differently. They chased validation, rotated through options and put status and independence first. They only started wanting something real once the attention slowed down and the options thinned out.

A woman who puts off commitment through her best years isn't always waiting for the right one. Often she's testing the market while her options are at their highest. Later, many suddenly care about family and stability, and expect you to ignore the history.
Don't become the plan B. Don't fund her second chapter when she lived the first one without you. And don't lower your standards just because she says she's finally ready.
Choose the woman whose past choices match the life she says she wants now. Not the one who only reached that realisation after her options ran out. Stay strict and filter hard.
closing: Save this before you get serious with someone.

Not much on its own. Her choices over the years tell you a lot.
